# Pitch

> Pitch turns any website URL into a cinematic, narrated product demo video. An autonomous AI agent opens a real browser, navigates the product, writes the script, records the screen with smooth cursor motion, and renders a 1080p MP4 — in minutes, with no recording or editing.

Pitch is built for founders, product marketers, and agencies who need polished product demo videos without the cost or turnaround of traditional production. Typical use cases include website hero videos, investor updates, demo-day pitches, sales outreach, onboarding walkthroughs, and changelog announcements.

## How it works

1. Drop your URL — the agent opens a real browser and navigates your live product.
2. Direct the scene — describe what to show in plain English, pick a voice, theme, and pace.
3. Receive the cut — a narrated, scored, color-graded 1080p MP4, editable scene-by-scene.

## Pricing

- Starter — $10/month, 10 credits (3 videos)
- Pro — $40/month, 50 credits (~16 videos), watermark removed
- Enterprise — custom volume
- One-time top-ups: 10 credits / $12, 50 credits / $45
- 3 credits = one full AI-generated demo video. Credits never expire.

## FAQ

- **How is Pitch different from Loom or other screen recorders?** Loom records you clicking around your product. Pitch is autonomous — an AI agent opens a real browser, navigates your product, writes the script, and produces a polished, narrated video with cinematic cursor motion and color grading. No recording, no editing.
- **How is Pitch different from Synthesia or HeyGen?** Synthesia and HeyGen generate talking-head avatars. Pitch shows your actual product — the AI agent navigates your real website and narrates what is happening on screen.
- **How long does it take?** Most videos generate in minutes once you submit your URL and instructions.
- **What does a video cost?** A full AI-generated demo video uses 3 credits (~$3 on Starter, ~$2.40 on Pro). Credits never expire.
- **Do I need to install anything or instrument my site?** No. You just provide a public URL. The agent uses a real browser — nothing to install, no SDK, no code change.
- **Can I edit the video after it's generated?** Yes. Edit captions, swap voices, or re-render individual scenes without regenerating the entire video.
- **Will the video have a watermark?** Free and Starter videos include a small "Powered by Pitch" watermark. Pro and Enterprise remove it.
